model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Фигура 5 (ляво) илюстрира промените в стойността на спарс реалното съотношение на изхода на SDPA (Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output) преди и след прилагането на врата. Оста X е обозначена като "Layer" и представлява линейна скала, варираща от 0 до 25, с интервали от 5. Оста Y е обозначена като "Sparsity Ratio" и представлява линейна скала, варираща от 0 до 1, с интервали от 0,2.

На графиката са изобразени две линии. Синaта пунктирана линия представлява "sparcity ratio after gate", започваща от около 0,2 при Layer 0 и леко се увеличаваща до около 0,3 при Layer 5, след което намалява до около 0,25 при Layer 10 и се стабилизира около 0,2 до Layer 25. Оранжевата пунктирана линия представлява "sparcity ratio before gate", започваща от около 0,8 при Layer 0 и постепенното намаляване до около 0,6 при Layer 5, след което намалява до около 0,45 при Layer 10 и достига до около 0,38 при Layer 25.
model_annotations.Chinese: 图 5（左）显示了层与稀疏度比率之间的关系。x 轴标记为“层”，范围从 0 到 20，为线性刻度，单位为层。x 轴的刻度间隔为 1。y 轴标记为“稀疏度比率”，范围从 0 到 1.0，为线性刻度。y 轴的刻度间隔为 0.1。图中有一条蓝色虚线，该虚线从 x 轴上 0 处的约 0.8 开始，在 x 轴上约 6 处达到约 0.75 的峰值，在 x 轴上约 10 处下降至约 0.65，然后相对稳定地波动到 x 轴末端，达到约 0.61。
model_annotations.English: Figure 5(left) illustrates the relationship between layer number and sparsity ratio after gating, with and without pre-gating. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled “Sparsity Ratio” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. There are two lines presented on this plot: a dashed blue line representing “sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.04," which begins at approximately 0.04 at Layer 0, rises to a maximum of 0.12 at Layer 5, then declines to approximately 0.08 at Layer 20; and a solid orange line representing “sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.18,” that starts at approximately 0.18 at Layer 0, reaches a maximum of 0.30 at Layer 5, and subsequently declines to approximately 0.24 at Layer 20.
model_annotations.German: Figure 5 (left) displays the absolute mean values before and after gating. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and is linear, ranging from 0 to 20, with tick marks at 2-unit intervals. The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" and is linear, ranging from 0 to 0.6, with tick marks at 0.1-unit intervals. Three lines are present: a solid, dark blue line representing "Hidden State mean before gate, avg 0.7," which begins at approximately 0.7 at Layer 0 and remains relatively constant at approximately 0.7 across all layers up to Layer 20; a dashed, medium blue line representing "Hidden State mean after gate avg 0.02," which begins at approximately 0.02 at Layer 0, shows a gradual increase to approximately 0.03 by Layer 5, then remains relatively constant around 0.03 through Layer 20; and a dotted, light blue line representing "Hidden State mean of baseline, avg 0.04," which begins at approximately 0.04 at Layer 0 and remains relatively constant at approximately 0.04 across all layers up to Layer 20.
